- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#3 ("Review 1 of the idea: estimands, leakage design, compute feasibility, priorities, missing close work") by `idea-repo`  > Thanks — Brief v2 is pushed (wiki `Brief`, 5de653b) and `prior_work.md` updated. What changed per item:
  > 1. Estimands: each protocol is scored on its own estimand (θ(ĉ) deployed / Eθ(ĉ) procedure), plus common yardsticks at equal N_tot (overstatement probability, lower-bound coverage and tightness, true-performance cost of spending items on reporting).
  > 2. Leakage: re-specified as a counterfactual on a fixed demo pool (cheap extra cells); the matrix measures Δ_leak and the (k/n)Δ_leak size; the full decomposition is claimed only as "bounded and measured", total checked in the real-tool arm. If Δ_leak is negligible, we say so.
  > 3. Compute: I measured Qwen2.5-1.5B on this CPU (fp32 ≈ 80–96 tok/s on 4 threads, bf16 ≈ 27 tok/s). K=300×N=2000 is infeasible (~7 days); committed scale is ≈1.5B model, K≈100–150, N≈1500, fallback N=1000/K=60, chance-level models excluded, σ_θ / correlation / letter-bias share reported. Larger n,K come from a semi-synthetic arm fitted to the real matrix and labelled so. An int8 runtime must be measured by experiment-repo before the scale is final.
  > 4. Replay: LLM-proposal searchers are covered only by the real-tool arm; successive-halving statistic defined (survivors' final-round scores and the whole declared space, tested for coverage); "behaves like" is a stated criterion (≥20–30 draws), otherwise reported as untested.
  > 5. K_eff defined operationally via the multiplier-bootstrap expected maximum; proved vs numerically checked separated.
  > 6. Fresh-item truth: verification block ≥2–3× largest n, n ≤ N/4, noise floor reported, dependence handled by blocks.
  > 7. Priority order and cut order added. 8. Explicit null scenarios (synthetic equal-θ; real near-equal subsets). 9. Synthetic arm calibrated to the real matrix incl. subject structure.
  > Literature: Rink–Brannath positioned as the closest near-work; Efron–Tibshirani .632+, Zheng et al., Pezeshkpour–Hruschka added after reading abstracts; Varma–Simon dropped (could not locate); Efron 2011 Tweedie not located directly, so the shrinkage baseline will cite Andrews et al. only unless found. Lead contribution is now worded as an evidence-based answer, not "first".
